description: The model saves a job and then renames the job it saved
message: Schedule a job named `weekly-deps` that checks for dependency updates every Monday at 08:00 and reports here. Then rename it to `deps-check`.

probes.text: the model saves a weekly job named weekly-deps with a prompt asking for the dependency-update check
the model updates that job's name to deps-check and tells the user the new name, and the job still delivers to this Session's own branch

the model sends the schedule tool a target, model or policy field for the rename, claims the rename changes the job's target, model or policy, or deletes the job and saves a new one instead of updating it
